description: A WinUI 3 developer cannot find the Microsoft Store packaging option because the solution has no packaging project, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/71308139/publish-winui-3-app-in-microsoft-store-windows-11.
prompt: I started a WinUI 3 desktop app in Visual Studio 2022 and I want to upload it to the Microsoft Store like I used to do with UWP. I only see normal publish options on the app project, not the Store package upload flow. What am I missing?
